name: bl-tourist-stay-tax
description: Saint-Barthelemy tourist stay tax (taxe de sejour) for 2026 under articles 123 to 125 bis of the Contributions Code as amended in 2024. Covers the 5% rate on the actual invoiced accommodation price (excluding catering and other ancillary services, regardless of guest numbers), the exemptions for seasonal workers and leases over six months, prior registration of furnished tourist lettings with a 13-digit number, who collects (hosts, hotels, intermediaries and platforms), the online and counter declaration and payment deadlines, and euro conversion at the chancery rate. Applies to the local taxe de sejour only. Trigger phrases include taxe de sejour Saint-Barthelemy, St Barts tourist tax 5%, villa rental tax Saint-Barth, comstbarth taxesejour.
